name: Istorija odnogo neudachnika (ION)
source: It seemed that the life of an ordinary loser Semyon Persunov, full of adversity and suffering, would not change anything. But now the 410th bus appears on the horizon, ready to take our hero for a ride on its windshield...
translation: 谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫这个普通失败者的生活充满了逆境和痛苦，似乎不会改变任何事情。但现在第410辆公共汽车出现在地平线上，准备载着我们的英雄在挡风玻璃上兜风……
